test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

The groceries are delivered to the house by the shopkeeper every evening.

options.text: The shopkeeper delivers the groceries to the house every evening.
The groceries were delivered to the house by the shopkeeper.
The shopkeeper had delivered the groceries to the house.
The groceries are being delivered to the house every evening.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To convert a sentence from passive voice to active voice, identify the subject performing the action (in this case, "the shopkeeper").
 
• The passive voice sentence is: "The groceries are delivered to the house by the shopkeeper every evening."
 
• In the active voice, the subject "the shopkeeper" comes first, followed by the verb "delivers" and the object "the groceries."
 
• Time phrase ("every evening") is retained at the end for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The shopkeeper delivers the groceries to the house every evening."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The groceries were delivered to the house by the shopkeeper." – Incorrect tense (past tense).
 
• **Option 3: **"The shopkeeper had delivered the groceries to the house." – Incorrect tense (past perfect).
 
• **Option 4: **"The groceries are being delivered to the house every evening." – Incorrect structure (present continuous passive).
